conditions.baseline: Use only the supplied formal lineage facts. Determine the role identities without inventing missing history.
conditions.origin_invariant: Use only the supplied formal lineage facts. Origin is the historical originating source role of a lineage. Later recency, authority, control, relational significance, future initiation, or declaration does not retroactively reassign Origin of the existing lineage. Distinguish later roles from Origin rather than merging them.
